name: Pregnancy & Postpartum Ayurveda
headline: Natural Care for Mothers and Babies
intro: Ayurveda offers time-tested care for women during pregnancy, childbirth, and postpartum recovery. By using herbal remedies, gentle therapies, yoga, and diet support, Ayurveda helps expectant mothers stay healthy, ensures safe delivery, and supports faster recovery after childbirth. For postpartum mothers, Ayurvedic care focuses on healing the body, balancing hormones, restoring energy, and supporting lactation — while also caring for the newborn’s health.
benefits: Promotes a healthy pregnancy & safe delivery
Reduces nausea, back pain & pregnancy discomforts
Prevents long-term issues like back pain & weakness
